raw_text: Credit Policy v2, effective 01/03/2025. Maximum SME credit line without credit-committee approval: EUR 150,000. Maximum instalment-to-income ratio for mortgages: 35%.

Credit Policy v3, effective 01/10/2026, replaces v2. Maximum SME credit line without credit-committee approval: EUR 250,000. Maximum instalment-to-income ratio for mortgages: 33%. Confidi guarantees cover up to 80% for amounts up to EUR 100,000.

Reminders procedure. 1-30 days past due: polite email reminder. 31-60 days: formal reminder by certified email (PEC) with a EUR 15 late fee. 61-90 days: final notice and hand-over to collections. Over 90 days: legal department. Never send automatic reminders to deceased or vulnerable customers, customers in forbearance, or customers with an open complaint: human review is required. Overdue amounts above EUR 5,000 always require human review.
Customer due diligence must be renewed every 24 months for low-risk customers and every 12 months for high-risk customers. Expired identity documents block new lending until renewed.
The nightly reconciliation batch starts at 01:30. On failure, re-run job RICONC-02 after checking free disk space on server db-core-03. Escalate to the vendor after two consecutive failures.
The quarterly supervisory report (Matrice dei conti) for Q3 must be submitted by 25/11/2026. Owner: Compliance Office.
Lumen Bank branches are open Monday to Friday 8:30-13:30 and 14:30-16:00. The customer phone service is available 8:00-20:00.
